description:
Using OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html), connect to the 'demodb' database (database user: admin, password: admin) and perform the following four record updates:

1. In the Hotels class, update the record where Name is 'Hotel Artemide': change the Stars field from 4 to 5.
2. In the Hotels class, update the record where Name is 'The Savoy': change the Phone field to '+44-20-7836-5555'.
3. In the Hotels class, update the record where Name is 'Copacabana Palace': change the Type field from 'Historic' to 'Palace'.
4. In the Profiles class, update the record where Email is 'luca.rossi@example.com': change the Surname field from 'Rossi' to 'De Rossi'.

You can execute UPDATE SQL statements via Studio's SQL/Browse console, or edit records directly through the Browse interface. All four updates must be applied and persisted in the database.
